reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering fairy items, seasonal seeds, a mysterious stone, food, fiber crops, forage, and minerals were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover machine acceleration, folklore, crop timing, established item names, planting instructions, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

FairyDust_Description.source: Sprinkle on kegs, furnaces, and other refining equipment to instantly receive their product.
FairyDust_Description.translation: Presară-l pe Butoaie, Cuptoare și alte echipamente de procesare pentru a primi instantaneu produsul lor.

FairyRose_Description.source: An old folk legend suggests that the sweet smell of this flower attracts fairies.
FairyRose_Description.translation: O veche legendă populară spune că mirosul dulce al acestei flori atrage zânele.

FairySeeds_Description.source: Plant in fall. Takes 12 days to produce a mysterious flower. Assorted Colors.
FairySeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le toamna. Au nevoie de 12 zile pentru a produce o floare misterioasă. Culori variate.

FairyStone_Description.source: An old miner's song suggests these are made from the bones of ancient fairies.
FairyStone_Description.translation: Un vechi cântec de miner spune că aceste pietre sunt făcute din oasele zânelor străvechi.

FallSeeds_Description.source: An assortment of wild fall seeds.
FallSeeds_Description.translation: Un amestec de semințe sălbatice de toamnă.

FarAwayStone_Description.source: A stone of unknown origins. Looks like it could be placed into something.
FarAwayStone_Description.translation: O piatră de origine necunoscută. Pare că ar putea fi așezată în ceva.

FarmersLunch_Description.translation: Îți va da putere să mergi mai departe.

FiberSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in any season. Does not require watering. Harvest with the scythe. Takes 7 days to grow.
FiberSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le în orice anotimp. Nu necesită udare. Recoltează-le cu coasa. Cresc în 7 zile.

FiddleheadFern_Description.source: The young shoots are an edible specialty.
FiddleheadFern_Description.translation: Lăstarii tineri sunt o specialitate culinară.

FiddleheadRisotto_Description.source: A creamy rice dish served with sauteed fern heads. It's a little bland.
FiddleheadRisotto_Description.translation: Un preparat cremos din orez, servit cu lăstari de ferigă sotați. Este puțin fad.

FieldSnack_Description.source: A quick snack to fuel the hungry forager.
FieldSnack_Description.translation: O gustare rapidă care-i dă energie culegătorului flămând.
